feature_title: archctl view Fase 5 — interactive C4 workbench
context: Static visual regression of the M17.1 C4 hierarchical workbench after loading the c4-container sample bundle. The workbench uses c4-container.json (1 Context + 3 Containers) and renders levels Context/Container with a Sidebar (Bundle metadata + node detail + Actions + Evidence + Relations). Renderer: archview/src/{App.tsx,views/C4View.tsx,components/Sidebar.tsx}; screenshots: Playwright at /tmp/opencode/cua-screenshots/.

criteria.name: empty-state topbar + canvas message
criteria.description: With no bundle loaded, the topbar exposes the seven sample buttons (one per kind, including 'Sample C4 container (archctl)') plus a bundle-URL text input and a 'drift mode' toggle. The main area shows an empty-canvas message
criteria.expected: Topbar has an <h1> with 'archview' text, exactly 7 sample-loader buttons (labels include 'Sample C4 container (archctl)' and 'Sample C4 context'), an empty <input> with placeholder 'bundle URL (file://… or http://…)', a 'drift mode' button, and a disabled '←' back arrow. Below the topbar the main column renders the literal text 'Load a bundle from the top bar to start exploring.' under a `.empty-canvas` class. No sidebar selection (no `.node-detail` block).

criteria.name: C4 levels (Context 1 + Container 3) rendered hierarchically
criteria.description: After clicking 'Sample C4 container (archctl)', the C4View renders the four-node bundle as two grouped levels under a 'All systems' breadcrumb, with the '▸ drill in' hint on the archctl Context node
criteria.expected: The `.c4-view` container shows a `.c4-breadcrumb` with a 'All systems' button (enabled). Two `.c4-level` blocks are visible: `c4-level-1` with heading 'Context (1)' and exactly one `.c4-element` button named 'archctl' that has a `.c4-drill-hint` with the text '▸ drill in'; `c4-level-2` with heading 'Container (3)' and three element buttons named 'CLI', 'LadybugDB Store', 'Manifest Gates'. No sidebar selection (no `.node-detail` block). No evidence/relations sections.

criteria.description: After clicking the '←' back arrow in the nav-history toolbar, the workbench drops the sidebar selection and returns to the C4 levels view (Context 1 + Container 3) with the breadcrumb reset to 'All systems'
criteria.expected: The '←' button is now enabled (it was disabled in c1). inconsistencies_found: Paradiam shift: Fase 5 describes a graph canvas (drag/zoom/click on nodes); the actual M17.1 UI is a hierarchical C4 view (levels Context/Container/Component rendered as <ul> lists). GraphView still exists for non-C4 bundles.

Bundle loading: Fase 5 says 'paste http://127.0.0.1:18777/api/export'; without --cwd that endpoint returns {empty:true, warning:'no project_dir configured'}. The human workflow is the 7 SAMPLE_BUNDLES buttons.
kind=contextL1 is rendered as TWO elements (text 'context' + L1 badge), never the literal string 'contextL1'.
'▸ drill in' is a hint label, not a clickable target — the click on the row does both select and drill-in.
Sidebar strings are English ('Actions', 'Evidence', 'Relations', 'no relations for this node'); Fase 5 is in Spanish.
Check 5.7 (console sin errores rojos) is not verifiable from static screenshots — out of scope for the rubric.
c4-container.json has evidenceCount:0; Fase 5 evidence check needs a real project (mini-redis) after c4-discover --apply, not the sample.
